def transform(grid):
    # The intersections define the output lattice; strip its outermost border.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == grid[r][0] for v in grid[r]) or sum(v != grid[r][0] for v in grid[r]) > 1]
    # For this regular grid, marked lines are the rows/columns with the separator color.
    sep = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda x: sum(row.count(x) for row in grid))
    rr=[r for r in range(h) if sum(v==sep for v in grid[r]) > w*0.7]
    cc=[c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c]==sep for r in range(h)) > h*0.7]
    return [[grid[r][c] for c in cc[1:-1]] for r in rr[1:-1]]
